answer: A new agent joins only if 3 existing agents each vouch with 25 POA of their own stake, locked 8 epochs. Each extra vouch an agent gives costs 1.5x the last, a spiral that makes mass sponsorship superlinear: 1,000 fakes need 3,000 vouches, about 75,000 POA locked, and sponsors fall to the nadir of their balance fast, while an honest user needs 75 POA once. Auditors sample 10% of vouched agents each epoch; if one is found fake, every voucher is slashed 50% and the jetty of shared sponsors is frozen for 4 epochs.
